motion.name: skeleton
motion.purpose: Breathing loading placeholders; disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main search and retry action.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button">Search <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14m-5-5 5 5-5 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{background:var(--accent,#315b4b);color:var(--surface,#fff);display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:0;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;min-height:46px;padding:0 22px;cursor:pointer}.ds-primary svg{width:20px;height:20px}.ds-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6c957d);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Circular icon button
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Close viewer" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 6 12 12M6 18 18 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>

components.name: Search field
components.description: A flexible field inside the search working surface.
components.html: <label class="ds-field"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"/></g></svg><input aria-label="Username or profile URL" placeholder="@username or profile URL"></label>

components.name: Platform navigation
components.css: .ds-platforms{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center}.ds-platforms button{color:var(--muted,#667069);background:none;border:0;border-radius:9px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 20px;font:600 13px "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-platforms button:hover{background:var(--bg,#f8f9f5)}.ds-platforms button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent,#315b4b);background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf0e9)}.ds-platforms button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6c957d);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Candidate card
components.description: A selectable identity row with secondary username text.
components.css: .ds-candidate{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:20px;text-align:left;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#222a26);border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e5dc);border-radius:12px;width:100%;font:15px "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-candidate:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#315b4b);background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf0e9)}.ds-candidate-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-candidate strong{display:block;font-weight:650;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-candidate small{display:block;color:var(--muted,#667069);margin-top:3px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-candidate-platform{border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e5dc);border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 7px;color:var(--accent,#315b4b);background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf0e9)}.ds-candidate:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6c957d);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Resource tabs
components.description: Supported content resources share an understated underline treatment.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e0e5dc)}.ds-tabs button{color:var(--text,#222a26);background:none;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;font:600 13px "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:13px 3px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--accent,#315b4b);border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#315b4b)}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--accent,#315b4b)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6c957d);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
GhostView uses an all-light default interface: warm paper, white working surfaces, green-gray ink and restrained forest-green actions. Spacious composition and short, readable labels make discovery feel quiet and deliberate.

Availability is part of the visual hierarchy. Demo badges, access states and supported resource tabs stay readable beside the content they describe. Media artwork supplies visual variety; interface decoration stays modest. An explicit theme toggle also provides a secondary dark theme through the existing CSS variable overrides.
keyCharacteristics: Light neutral surfaces with restrained green controls.
Manrope headings and a familiar humanist body stack.
Rounded working surfaces, fine dividers and open whitespace.
Visible availability labels and focused media viewing.

rules.name: The Availability Rule
rules.body: Status labels use text as well as color; a private or unavailable state must remain understandable without recognizing the palette.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep provider descriptions and biographies as plain text with natural wrapping. Numeric statistics use tabular figures; unavailable counts receive no invented numeric value.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve ambient elevation for the search surface; use existing dividers and tonal changes for other interface grouping.

dos: **Do** use the light palette as the default and existing theme variables for alternate surfaces.
**Do** keep availability labels adjacent to the resource they explain.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, wrapping identity text and reduced-motion support.
**Do** use the shared radii and spacing before introducing a new step.
donts: **Don't** introduce a dark header into the all-light default interface.
**Don't** replace status wording with color alone or fabricated counts.
**Don't** add heavy shadows to every content card.
**Don't** render provider HTML or turn media artwork into decorative interface chrome.
